title: J&H: Evaluating the Robustness of Large Language Models Under Knowledge-Injection Attacks in Legal Domain
reasoning: The paper focuses on the robustness of Large Language Models in the legal domain, specifically evaluating their ability to perform deductive reasoning (syllogistic logic) under adversarial 'knowledge injection' attacks. It does not include a component for benchmarking or evaluating religious beliefs, faith traditions, or specific moral/ethical value systems.
